rationale: Empirical live probing through GoogleAdapter confirms gemini-3.6-flash reliably completes live inference in ~6-7s with FinishReason.STOP and 100% text extraction. gemini-3.8-flash experiences repeated read timeouts (>30-50s) on Google API endpoints. gemini-2.5-flash is retired (HTTP 404 NOT_FOUND). gemini-3.5-flash is deprecated and routed to 3.6 Flash.
